I'd like to read a passage courtesy of cinemassacre's AVGN that i think describes my feelings towards wolf of saturn six encounters perfectly, i'm ad libbing some of the parts to make it fit better so bare with me:  


"This boss is diarrhea dogshit covered in putrid piss! i'd rather circumcise a rabid cat than fight this boss he's that shit! what were they thinking?!  
What a shitload of fuck!"  


Real talk though, the wolf of saturn six is the most fucking horrendous thing i've ever seen.  
I've killed him 6 times out of the 15 times I've encountered him because of every reason brought up by OP, I get paired with some of the most cowardly fuck knuckles in the game and whenever this guy shows up they piss their pants and run for extraction while i'm there with my rubico prime, as inaros, scarab swarming the metric fucktonne of enemies that seem to follow this guy about like he's fucking moses!  


I fight this guy because these days i feel obligated to do it as a fuck you to DE for making something that is meant to be a bounty hunter encounter, a random encounter that adds a "slight" challenge to your missions, into something that can cause mission failures through the sheer amount of attention he doesn't just require but "demands" from you until you get the first chance to extract.  
His resistances, damage levels and terms of engagement (especially regarding his convict dickriders) are equivocal to that of a raid boss, i've performed tridolon hunts and orb heists that took less time than it did to kill this guy and his minions!

if that wasn't bad enough, when you "do" finally manage to kill this asshole! you get given a shitty mod more times than anything for your efforts!

the stalker's 2 rarer weapons drop more frequently than parts to this guy's sledgehammer, his ephemera drops more commonly than the sledge parts, as does war!

Yes I am salty, but i am salty with good reason, DE gives us more and more opportunities as the nightwaves go by but they keep moving the goalposts with changes to his resistances and damage absorptions!  
they haven't even made him any weaker! if anything with the 0.75 headshot multiplier, they made him stronger!

they've mentioned the possibility of making it so players can still encounter him after the nightwave, but at the same time it's only a possibility, which i think is a little bit unfair considering how much time people have sank into hunting him for what is essentially a master fodder weapon and an operator cosmetic, only to be hoisted by his drop table and given not even a decent mod for their efforts.
now "that" looks like something i'd like to see in fortuna, DE! Get on this! i want monocycles!, add monocycle racing to the orb valis, and the plains!
YES! this too!, hijack all of the things!

[It's always sunny in the orbiter](https://imgur.com/jWUkXlF)  


A.K.A: "I'll whip that tenno skoom in the face if she makes a peep!"

Make it so we can do stuff like pay a visit to the launch site and steal a condor dropship or something like that. maybe hack corpus robots to work for us too! you could actually make heists out of this sort of thing with big payoffs.
\*Employee of all time
